# AMLL player packages

The local packages in this directory were built from `applemusic-like-lyrics-main` at source revision `6162921`:

- `applemusic-like-lyrics-core-0.6.0.tgz`
- `applemusic-like-lyrics-react-0.6.0.tgz`
- `applemusic-like-lyrics-react-full-0.5.0.tgz`

The app references these archives through `file:` dependencies in `package.json`. `applemusic-like-lyrics-main-player-source.zip` contains the corresponding `core`, `react`, and `react-full` package sources plus the upstream license.

These upstream packages are licensed under AGPL-3.0-only. Keep the license and corresponding source with redistributed builds, and make any required modified source available under the license terms.
